# Benign baseline

Every event file under this folder is treated as normal activity. A rule's noise is
`benign alerts / host-days`, where host-days are counted from the data itself.

* `synthetic/` is generated by `sigmaforge baseline generate` (seeded, byte-for-byte
  reproducible; CI checks it against `baseline/corpus.lock.json`). Not committed.
* `real/` is for exports from your own lab VM (`scripts/Export-SysmonBaseline.ps1`).
  Git-ignored because it gets large. Use Git LFS or a pinned release asset if you want CI
  to use it.

Formats: `.jsonl`, `.json`, `.evtx`, optionally `.gz`. ECS / Winlogbeat documents are
mapped back to Sysmon field names automatically.
